ask_for_administrator_permission_every_t: Ask for administrator permission every time mausVoice starts, instead of configuring input permissions manually. Takes effect on the next launch.
assign_a_shortcut_to_select_a_style_dire: Assign a shortcut to select a style directly. Leave a row empty to disable its shortcut.
capture_organized_notes_decisions_and_ne: Capture organized notes, decisions, and next steps.
choose_prompt_bullets_concise_or_notes_s: Choose Prompt, Bullets, Concise, or Notes styles, bind a shortcut to any style, and cycle active styles with the activation key plus arrow keys.
choose_which_monitor_the_pill_returns_to: Choose which monitor the pill returns to when you reset its position: the monitor the pill is on, or the monitor your mouse is on.
configure_a_text_generation_provider_to_: Configure a text-generation provider to use Voice Edit Mode.
configures_global_input_capture_uinput_u: Configures global input capture (uinput/udev) so the pill can type for you. Requires administrator privileges.
decide_how_mausvoice_should_transcribe_y: Decide how mausVoice should transcribe your recordings, locally on your machine or through a connected provider.
discard_common_fabricated_phrases_produc: Discard common fabricated phrases produced when the microphone hears silence or noise.
edit_the_text_before_inserting_it: Edit the text before inserting it.
grants_administrator_privileges_and_inpu: Grants administrator privileges and input-capture access so the pill can type for you. You will see a User Account Control prompt.
hold_the_dictate_activation_key_and_pres: Hold the dictate activation key and press Left or Right Arrow to cycle active styles.
how_long_the_assistant_waits_for_approva: How long the assistant waits for approval before denying a tool call.
limits_how_many_tool_use_turns_one_reque: Limits how many tool-use turns one request can run.
make_it_sound_like_a_professional_but_fr: Make it sound like a professional but friendly email. Use jargon and fun words.
make_this_shorter_or_turn_it_into_bullet: Make this shorter or turn it into bullets
multilingual_local_asr_with_strong_silen: Multilingual local ASR with strong silence handling (no punctuation)
name: Name
new_styles_local_transcription_audio_imp: New styles, local transcription, audio import, and a reviewable composer
open_an_editable_composer_so_you_can_rev: Open an editable composer so you can review or change dictated text before it is inserted.
organize_the_dictation_into_clear_scanna: Organize the dictation into clear, scannable bullets.
requests_accessibility_and_microphone_ac: Requests Accessibility and Microphone access so the pill can type for you. You will be prompted in System Settings.
say_the_same_thing_with_fewer_sharper_wo: Say the same thing with fewer, sharper words.
sensevoice_adds_fast_multilingual_local_: SenseVoice adds fast multilingual local transcription without punctuation, while the silence filter reduces fabricated text from quiet audio. You can also import recordings from your History page.
some_style_shortcuts_overlap_and_may_be_: Some style shortcuts overlap and may be difficult to trigger.
the_application_encountered_an_unexpecte: The application encountered an unexpected error.
the_user_has_dictated_the_following_comm: The user has dictated the following command: ------- {transcript} ------- Execute this command and provide the output in {languageName}. Instructions: - If the user asks you to write, create, draft, or compose something → produce that content - If the user asks you to summarize, analyze, or explain something → provide the summary/analysis/explanation - If the user asks you to transform or rewrite something → apply the transformation - If the user provides a statement without a clear command → clean it up and present it clearly Return ONLY the requested output, nothing else. The output will be pasted directly into the user's application.
this_model_is_likely_too_heavy_for_this_: This model is likely too heavy for this device. A smaller model is strongly recommended.
this_model_may_be_slow_on_this_device_co: This model may be slow on this device. Consider a smaller model.
this_model_may_not_run_well_on_this_devi: This model may not run well on this device
this_requires_administrator_privileges_t: This requires administrator privileges to configure global input capture (uinput/udev). Continue?
this_will_prompt_for_administrator_privi: This will prompt for administrator privileges (UAC) so the pill can capture and type input globally. Continue?
this_will_request_accessibility_and_micr: This will request Accessibility and Microphone access so the pill can capture and type input globally. Continue?
turn_a_rambling_dictation_into_a_concise: Turn a rambling dictation into a concise, intent-preserving prompt.
turn_on_review_before_insert_to_edit_dic: Turn on Review before insert to edit dictated text in a composer, use voice Edit Mode for transformations, and configure which Agent Mode tools may run.
voice_editing_is_not_supported_on_this_p: Voice editing is not supported on this platform
windows_declined_the_administrator_promp: Windows declined the administrator prompt. mausVoice will keep running without administrator privileges — input capture may not work in apps that run as administrator.
